name: Elmer Frye
summary: Elmer Frye was a Dunwich farmer on the eastern edge of Cold Spring Glen whose household was awakened by stench and barking dogs in the second phase of the horror, and whose entire family and farm were annihilated that night.
description:
A frightful stench and the savage barking of dogs awakened the household at Elmer Frye's, on the eastern edge of Cold Spring Glen. Frye lit a lantern through force of habit, but knew it would be death to go out into the black farmyard; his wife proposed telephoning the neighbors just as the noise of splintering wood burst in upon their deliberations.

The Elmer Fryes were erased from Dunwich that night — their house caved in, and nothing living or dead could be found amongst the ruins.
fate: He and his household were erased from Dunwich when their house caved in and nothing living or dead could be found amongst the ruins.
